b1-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Do at Work
b1-06-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about your job in Budapest. You work in an office, you are responsible for coordinating a small team, and you have five years of experience.
b1-06-01.prompt: Tell Meg where you work, what you are responsible for and how much experience you have.
cues: Say what you are responsible for
Say how much experience you have
b1-06-01.target: Trabajo en una oficina y soy responsable de coordinar un equipo pequeño. Tengo cinco años de experiencia.
b1-06-01.english: I work in an office and I am responsible for coordinating a small team. I have five years of experience.
b1-06-01.canDo: I can describe a professional role using the present tense.

b1-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Before and Now
b1-06-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether your work is different from before. You used to work for a small company, and now your position has more responsibilities.
b1-06-02.prompt: Tell Meg what you used to do and how your position is different now.
cues: Say where you used to work
b1-06-02.target: Antes trabajaba en una empresa pequeña, pero ahora tengo un puesto con más responsabilidades.
b1-06-02.english: I used to work for a small company, but now I have a position with more responsibilities.
b1-06-02.canDo: I can contrast former and current professional situations.

b1-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Job Advert
b1-06-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg is looking for work and asks what the advert you found says. A person with experience is wanted, a good level of English is required, and working from home two days a week is permitted.
b1-06-03.prompt: Tell Meg what the advert says about the person, the English and working from home.
cues: Say what level of English is required
Say when working from home is permitted
b1-06-03.target: Se busca una persona con experiencia. Se requiere buen nivel de inglés y se permite trabajar desde casa dos días a la semana.
b1-06-03.english: A person with experience is wanted. A good level of English is required and working from home two days a week is permitted.
b1-06-03.canDo: I can describe workplace rules and processes impersonally.

b1-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Problem at the Office
b1-06-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You come home late and Meg asks what happened at the office. There was an error in a report, so your team had to repeat the analysis, and that caused a delay.
b1-06-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the error was and what the team had to do because of it.
cues: Say the cause of the problem
Say what you had to do
b1-06-04.target: Debido a un error en el informe, tuvimos que repetir el análisis. Por eso hubo un retraso.
b1-06-04.english: Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis. So there was a delay.
b1-06-04.canDo: I can explain workplace problems through cause and consequence.

b1-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Story of Bartleby
b1-06-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have just read the story of Bartleby, and Carlos asks what happens in it. The copyist rejects the tasks, there are many delays, and in the end the lawyer moves his office to another building.
b1-06-05.prompt: Retell the story of Bartleby to Carlos in two sentences.
cues: Say who Bartleby is and what he does
Say what the lawyer does in the end
b1-06-05.target: Bartleby es un copista, pero rechaza las tareas y hay muchos retrasos. Al final, el abogado cambia su oficina a otro edificio.
b1-06-05.english: Bartleby is a copyist, but he rejects the tasks and there are many delays. In the end, the lawyer moves his office to another building.
b1-06-05.canDo: I can communicate professionally about requests and limitations.

b1-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Request You Cannot Accept
b1-06-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg is helping you practise what to say at work tomorrow. A client will ask you to deliver the report tomorrow, but you have to finish another project first.
b1-06-consolidation.prompt: Tell the client you understand the request, but refuse politely, give your reason and ask for a new deadline.
b1-06-consolidation.target: Entiendo la petición, pero no puedo entregar el informe mañana porque tengo que terminar otro proyecto. Necesito aclarar un nuevo plazo.
b1-06-consolidation.english: I understand the request, but I cannot deliver the report tomorrow because I have to finish another project. I need to clarify a new deadline.
b1-06-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about work, obligation, refusal and explanation in a professional setting.
